name: Zara

basis.note: Online orders: 30 days from the shipment date. Store purchases: 30 days from purchase.

outcome.note: Refunded to the original payment method; drop-off costs are deducted.

conditions.value: Original condition with all labels, returned in the same country where you bought it.

processing.value: Processed within 72 hours of reaching Zara's facility; banks can take up to 14 days

value.without: In store, show your Zara QR code or the receipt.

timing.value: Processed within 72 hours of reaching Zara's facility; banks can take up to 14 days

fees.label: Drop-off return
fees.amount: $4.95 per return request, deducted from the refund
fees.appliesTo: Online orders returned at a drop-off point

methods.label: Return at a Zara store
steps: Bring the items to a Zara store in the US
Show your Zara QR code or the receipt
methods.note: The QR code or the receipt works.

methods.label: Drop-off point
steps: Start a return from your order on zara.com
Take the package to the drop-off point
